text:
elaine.marketing: Quick ask for launch docs: can runtime run a disciplined mini-bench so we can cite p50/p95/p99 and a conservative cost estimate? Need artifacts for blog + webinar. cc @sam.runtime @jen.metrics

sam.runtime: Yep. What quant profile, model rev, and exact deliverables?

elaine.marketing: Use model redwood-alpha-8k@rev21, tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v5. Quant: q4_2-stable. Cohort N=60. Deliver: CSV with p50/p95/p99 per-slice, cost per 1M tokens, coldstart heatmap PNG, 20 anonymized raw traces, a one-paragraph methods blurb, and run_config.json. Please embargo until launch.

mike.eng: We'll need seed and sample slices. Also confirm whether to run prefix/KV cache on (matches prod) and if you want a cache=off coldstart slice.

elaine.marketing: Seed 77777. Use the marketing-samplepack-v3 and include slices: interactive, long-context (>3k), and short. Keep cache=on for the main run, and add a cache=off coldstart slice with --warmup 0 (10 samples) for heatmap. Batching: auto to reflect production.

sam.runtime: Plan: enqueue cohort=mini60 seed=77777 model=redwood-alpha-8k@rev21 tokenizer=rwd-tokenizer-v5 variants="q4_2-stable,fp16" context=8192 batching=auto cache=on tags=marketing,launch. Then run coldstart slice cache=off --warmup 0 N=10. We'll compute cost using internal-pricing-2026 and include delta vs baseline.

jen.metrics: Please include bootstrap CIs for p95 and show per-slice tables. For cost, state the price table used and any assumptions (e.g., average tokens per sample).

sam.runtime: Will do. Command we will enqueue:
```
enqueue-bench --cohort mini60 --seed 77777 --model redwood-alpha-8k@rev21 --tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v5 --variants "q4_2-stable,fp16" --context 8192 --batching auto --cache on --tags marketing,embargoed,priority
```

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: Job queued: #3707 by sam.runtime  status: pending runners (https://rundashboard/jobs/3707)

sam.runtime: ETA start 05:30 UTC tomorrow, expected runtime ~2.5h. If queue pressure, we'll run a prioritized N=30 pass for percentiles and heatmap and then backfill traces. We'll upload artifacts to /share/marketing/benchpacks/1733333333/ and ping when ready.

elaine.marketing: Great. Can you also scrub traces of any IDs and replace user identifiers with consistent pseudonyms? We'll need that for external slides.

sam.runtime: Yes, we'll include a pseudonym map and redact hostnames. We'll attach run_config.json and an annotations.txt describing slices and warmup defaults.

jen.metrics: I'll review outputs and confirm cost calc. If p95 CIs overlap baseline, we'll recommend softer language in the blog.

sam.runtime: Noted. Tag me if any extra slices are needed (e.g., forced-batching=off for single-request fast-lane numbers).

elaine.marketing: Thanks everyone 44f. Please tag me when artifacts are uploaded so I can start drafting the press lines and speaker notes.
